discrepancy_investigated.previous_report_claim: AudioEffectHardLimiter(ceiling_db = -1.2 dB) with recorded Master peak = -0.46 dBFS
discrepancy_investigated.root_cause: Measurement tap-order bug + fragile bus-effect index. In Godot 4.5, AudioServer.add_bus_effect(bus_idx, effect, 0) inserts at slot 0 and shifts existing effects down to slot 1+. The previous audit script inserted AudioEffectRecord at Master slot 0 BEFORE AudioEffectHardLimiter, recording the pre-limiter Master sum (-0.46 dBFS) instead of post-limiter Master output.
code_fixes: systems/AudioManager.gd: _ensure_master_limiter() pins AudioEffectHardLimiter(ceiling_db=-1.2, pre_gain_db=0.0, release=0.1) to Master slot 0 and exposes create_post_limiter_recorder() + get_master_limiter_info().
tests/test_full_game_integration.gd: Added 2 regression assertions verifying post-limiter recorder index > limiter_effect_index and Master bus_volume_db == 0.0 dB.
tools/automated_playthrough_driver.gd: Captures pre-limiter AudioEffectCapture (slot 0) and post-limiter AudioEffectRecord (slot 2) simultaneously during live Boss combat.

controlled_overload_burst_check.input_stimulus: 8 overlapping simultaneous game SFX voices at full volume on Master bus

live_boss_combat_recording.tap_point: Master bus effect index after AudioEffectHardLimiter (post-limiter)

scope_note: Waveform/numerical verification only; does not substitute for human ear evaluation of mix aesthetics.
